jobs.title: Senior Structural Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** Our client, an engineering firm specializing in renewable energy, water, and environmental solutions, is seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer** to manage projects, lead multidisciplinary teams, and support the design of hydroelectric, fisheries, and water resource infrastructure. This role combines technical design and project leadership responsibilities, including structural analysis of concrete and steel systems, coordination across engineering disciplines, and direct client interaction throughout project execution. The Senior Structural Engineer will oversee multiple projects, ensure quality and consistency in deliverables, and contribute to team development and long\-term client relationships. **This is a full\-time position open to candidates located in Portland, OR; Redmond, WA; Essex, CT; Falmouth, ME; and Pittsfield, ME.** **Pay range: $112,000 \- $170,000 DOE** **Benefits:*** Comprehensive medical/dental/vision package * 401(k) with 4% employer match and 100% immediate vesting * 10 Floating Holidays * Company Paid Short\-Term Disability and Life Insurance * Paid Parental Leave * Tuition Assistance * Employee Ownership **Responsibilities:*** Technical Expertise and Design Leadership: * Perform advanced structural engineering analysis and design, applying standard and advanced engineering principles across complex projects. * Develop and implement improved techniques, procedures, and design solutions that enhance technical capabilities. * Review analyses and designs to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement. * Apply interdisciplinary engineering knowledge, including regulatory and permitting considerations. * Serve as a technical lead on multi\-discipline projects and may act as a Discipline Group Leader. * Project Management and Execution: * Manage or support multiple projects, overseeing scope, schedule, and quality of deliverables. * Coordinate detailed phases of engineering work and ensure alignment across project teams. * Estimate resource needs, assign tasks, and monitor progress to meet deadlines. * Provide leadership on project scope, objectives, budgets, and execution strategies. * Client and Team Collaboration: * Lead client meetings and serve as a representative of the firm. * Build and maintain strong client relationships to support ongoing and future work. * Collaborate with internal teams across disciplines to deliver integrated project solutions. * Mentor and guide junior staff, including reviewing work for QA/QC and supporting development. * Business Development and Ownership: * Support proposal development and contribute to competitive positioning of the firm. * Maintain and grow relationships with existing and prospective clients. * Contribute to internal and external technical knowledge sharing through training, presentations, or publications. **Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an ABET\-accredited program or related field. * Licensed Professional Engineer (PE). * 10\+ years of experience in structural engineering. * Experience with hydroelectric, fisheries, or water resource projects preferred. * Specialized experience within structural engineering such as seismic design or finite element modeling is a plus. * Strong knowledge of engineering principles, standards, and codes applicable to structural engineering (e.g., AISC, IEEE, ASME). * Experience with analysis and design of concrete and steel structures, particularly in and around water environments. * Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams including hydrology/hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and geotechnical engineers. * Proficiency with structural modeling and design software such as MathCAD, RISA\-3D, SAP2000, AutoCAD, and Revit. * Proficiency with CAD software and discipline\-specific engineering tools. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage projects and client relationships. * Experience working with clients and contractors during planning and construction phases. * Familiarity with regulatory and permitting processes is a plus. * Proven experience managing project teams, including junior and senior staff, drafters, and coordinators. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and meet deadlines. * Experience serving as a Project Manager and/or Technical Lead on multidisciplinary projects. * Experience preparing proposals and supporting business development efforts. * Ability to build and maintain long\-term client relationships and contribute to ongoing business development. * Passion for mentoring and developing junior staff, including reviewing work for quality and consistency. * Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams across all phases of a project lifecycle. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, and Outlook. * Ability to develop and expand technical specialties within the discipline and contribute to knowledge sharing. * Must possess permanent authorization to work in the United States and be able to acquire authorization to work in Canada. * Must be willing to travel and possess a valid driver’s license. Work sponsorship is not available at this time. Third\-party candidates will not be considered for this position. jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

jobs.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Amazon Sponsored Products and Brands is looking for a talented Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join the Global Optimization Science team at the forefront of advertising technology innovation. We are working backwards from emerging markets to reimagine Amazon's advertising stack from the ground up, leveraging multilingual and multi\-modal GenAI technologies — including semantic hash designs, LLMs, and more — to deliver solutions that scale worldwide from day one. This is your opportunity to be part of a small, high\-impact team that prototypes, invents, and ships state\-of\-the\-art solutions that will define the future of digital advertising. The ideal candidate combines entrepreneurial drive with deep technical expertise, thriving in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where you define the path forward with minimal structure. Our team regularly goes from ideas on the whiteboard to production\-grade experiments. Your Customer Obsession fuels your passion for translating science into real\-world value for millions of advertisers and customers worldwide. You are consistently Right, A Lot when navigating complex technical decisions, demonstrating the rare ability to identify solutions that drive maximum impact with minimal resources. Whether you're architecting scalable GenAI systems or optimizing multi\-task recommendation engines, you cut through complexity to find the solutions that deliver the most results. Your GenAI experience goes beyond theoretical knowledge—you have successfully delivered value with state\-of\-the\-art technologies at Amazon scale, understanding both the promise and practical challenges of deploying machine learning in production environments (evaluations, etc.). You're not just an engineer—you're a builder who sees the bigger picture and knows how to make it reality. Key job responsibilities * Architect next\-generation systems that replace legacy monolithic infrastructure with scalable, intelligent solutions that scale worldwide on day one. * Pioneer breakthrough applied science in multi\-modal GenAI applications for advertising, combining text, image, and multi\-lingual support. * Drive end\-to\-end innovation from research ideation through production deployment at Amazon scale. * Lead cross\-functional collaboration with product, science, and business teams to translate science into customer impact. About the team You will join a newly\-founded team with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, with a focus on driving growth of sponsored products ad experiences across Amazon stores worldwide. This broad charter gives us the flexibility to explore and apply scientific techniques to novel product problems. You will have the satisfaction of seeing your work improve the experience of millions of Amazon shoppers worldwide while driving quantifiable revenue impact. More importantly, you will have the opportunity to broaden your technical skills, and be a science leader in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, WA, SEATTLE \- 168,100\.00 \- 227,400\.00 USD annually

Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity\-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. **Sr. Digital Product Manager, Forecasting** **What you will do** Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the strategy, discovery, development, and adoption of high\-impact digital products that improve how Amgen forecasts, plans, evaluates scenarios, and makes complex business decisions. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology to translate sophisticated analytical capabilities into intuitive, trusted, and scalable products. **Key responsibilities include:** * Translate Amgen’s digital strategy into product visions, roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes. * Develop a deep understanding of customer decisions, workflows, assumptions, and planning challenges across Commercial, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and R\&D. * Frame complex and ambiguous business problems as product opportunities, identifying where forecasting, optimization, simulation, scenario planning, automation, or AI\-enabled decision support can improve outcomes. * Partner with business leaders, data scientists, engineers, architects, and designers to translate analytical methods and models into scalable and usable digital products. * Ensure forecasting and decision\-support products make assumptions, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and model outputs understandable and actionable, with appropriate monitoring of model performance, adoption, and business outcomes. * Influence senior stakeholders, reconcile competing priorities, and align cross\-functional teams around a shared product vision, roadmap, and measures of success. * Identify opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic capabilities, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation while supporting responsible AI, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. * Establish effective operating rhythms, decision rights, documentation, and communication practices for globally distributed teams. * Drive product adoption and value realization by measuring impact on business performance, efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience. * Mentor product managers and contribute to an outcome\-oriented product culture across Amgen. **What we expect of you** We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. In this role, you will serve as the connective tissue between business strategy, customer needs, data science, and technology. **Basic Qualifications:** Doctorate degree and 2 years of Digital Product Management experience OR Master’s degree and 6 years of Digital Product Management experience OR Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Digital Product Management experience OR Associate’s degree and 10 years of Digital Product Management experience OR High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Digital Product Management experience In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years’ experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Product Management and Product Mindset + Proven digital product leader with experience connecting business strategy, customer needs, data and analytics, and technology. + Experience leading data\-intensive, analytical, or decision\-support products from discovery through launch, adoption, and scaling. + Demonstrated ability to translate complex decisions, planning processes, and analytical methods into compelling product strategies and intuitive customer exper ion, simulation, scenario planning, machine learning, or other advanced analytical capabilities. + Ability to partner effectively with data scientists and technical teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate model outputs, uncertainty, and limitations to nontechnical stakeholders. + Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, consumer products, manufacturing, supply chain, or another complex planning environment is preferred. * Leadership and Interpersonal + Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional product teams and drive execution without relying solely on formal authority. + Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate competing priorities, and create alignment in ambiguous environments. + Exceptional communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, including translating complex analytical and technical topics into clear business narratives. + Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones. + Experience mentoring product managers or other senior individual contributors and strengthening broader product management capabilities. **What you can expect of us** As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include: * A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts * A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales\-based incentive plan * Stock\-based long\-term incentives * Award\-winning time\-off plans * Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team. **careers.amgen.com** In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. **Application deadline** Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. **Sponsorship** Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed. As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Apple Ads
jobs.description: At Apple, we build products and services that enrich people’s lives. jobs.title: 3D Product Configurator & Commerce Integration
jobs.description: **Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration** Drive Commerce / WebGL, integrated with SAP S/4HANA, Centric PLM and PIM/MDM **About Us** Atlas Systems Inc. is a software solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas delivers solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare and ERP for customers worldwide, combining more than two decades of software experience with global reach and deep expertise across multiple industry verticals. This role sits within our enterprise retail practice, supporting a premium consumer\-products brand’s direct\-to\-consumer personalization program — where customers configure personalized products (imprinting, embroidery, laser engraving, monogramming, and color / material options) through interactive 3D experiences that must flow cleanly into an SAP S/4HANA\-based commerce and manufacturing backbone. To apply: https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/617 **Role Snapshot** **Job Title** Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration **Location** United States (remote, with periodic on\-site at the client site as required) **Work Model** Hybrid / Remote **Experience** 8\+ years **Employment Type** Full\-time **Position Summary** We are seeking a Senior Engineer to own the technical implementation, architecture and support of interactive 3D product\-configuration experiences — and, critically, their integration into the enterprise product\-data and order ecosystem. This is not a rendering\-only role. Success depends equally on a high\-fidelity 3D front end and on translating each customer configuration into a correct, orderable SKU, Bill of Materials and price within SAP S/4HANA. You will be the primary engineering owner for the configurator platform (Drive Commerce / WebGL) and its connections to the commerce platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), product lifecycle management (Centric PLM), the PIM / MDM layer (Precisely EnterWorks), integration middleware (webMethods), and downstream order management and fulfillment (Manhattan / WMS). In short: you make sure that what the customer configures on screen is exactly what gets priced, ordered, manufactured and shipped. **Key Responsibilities** **3D Configurator Engineering** * **Configurator ownership —** Own end\-to\-end development of interactive 3D web configurators built on the Drive Commerce plugin\-based JavaScript / WebGL framework (Three.js and / or Babylon.js). * **Performance —** Deliver responsive, performant experiences across mobile and desktop against defined performance budgets for load time, frame rate and memory. * **Stability —** Diagnose and resolve rendering, texture and canvas issues, including browser memory leaks and WebGL context loss. * **Technical leadership —** Lead architecture, code review and feature delivery for real\-time product personalization. **Configuration\-to\-Order Integration (core to this role)** * **Recipe** **SAP —** Design and maintain the mapping from a customer’s 3D “recipe” to a valid, orderable outcome in SAP S/4HANA — resolving each configuration to the correct material / SKU, Bill of Materials and price, using SAP variant configuration / configurable materials and made\-to\-order flows as applicable. * **Master\-data sync —** Keep the configurator’s variant / option matrix in sync with master data governed in Centric PLM and Precisely EnterWorks, so options, prices and availability stay accurate. * **End\-to\-end flow —** Build and maintain integrations across the commerce platform, middleware (webMethods / APIs), OMS and fulfillment (Manhattan), delivering accurate build sheets, pick lists and BOMs to manufacturing. * **Availability logic —** Implement made\-to\-order availability and lead\-time logic in the configuration experience (finished\-product availability and lead times, not raw\-material inventory). **Data, Pricing \& Accuracy** * **Data contracts —** Establish stable data contracts (JSON payloads, catalog indexes, option and price models) between the front end and back\-end systems. * **Accuracy —** Ensure price and SKU accuracy end to end, so the configured price and product match what is ordered, invoiced and manufactured. * **Color fidelity —** Implement ICC\-based color management so on\-screen color matches the manufactured product across materials, thread, print and engraving. * **Moderation —** Implement personalization safeguards — profanity and trademark / brand moderation on custom text and uploaded logos. **Asset \& Pipeline Collaboration** * **Asset workflows —** Partner with 3D design / asset teams (internal or agency) to translate high\-fidelity CAD / mesh assets into optimized web assets, communicating payload, texture and performance constraints. Deep 3D artistry and shader authoring are a plus, not the primary function of this role. * **Versioning —** Maintain versioned asset and configuration pipelines with clear release control. **Quality, Performance \& Support** * **Metrics e production support for the configurator and its integrations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant e\-commerce storefront and / or product\-configurator development. * Hands\-on experience with web\-based 3D graphics — WebGL with Three.js and / or Babylon.js — including performance optimization and browser memory management. * Demonstrated experience integrating a storefront or configurator with enterprise back\-end systems — ERP (ideally SAP), PLM and / or PIM / MDM — covering product master data, pricing and BOM / order flows. This is the key differentiator for the role. * Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and modern front\-end framework experience (React or Next.js; Vue acceptable), REST / GraphQL API design and state management. * Experience delivering complex visual and commerce software within cross\-functional agile teams. **Preferred / Strongly Desired** * Drive Commerce Customizer / 3D Configurator Platform and Drive Recipe API, or a comparable configurator platform. * Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA / OCAPI / cartridges), or an equivalent enterprise commerce platform. * SAP integration experience — variant configuration / configurable materials, material master, pricing and BOM; integration middleware such as web Methods. * Centric PLM and / or Precisely Enter Works, or comparable PLM / PIM / MDM platforms. * Manhattan or comparable WMS / order\-fulfillment integration. * ICC color management and personalization / customization commerce experience (imprint, embroidery, engraving, monogramming). **Technical Skills** * **Front\-end \& 3D:** JavaScript / TypeScript, WebGL, Three.js / Babylon.js, React / Next.js, shaders and materials (working knowledge), responsive UX, browser performance profiling. * **Integration \& data:** REST / GraphQL APIs, JSON / XML transforms, event and middleware patterns (webMethods or similar), product\-data and SKU / variant modeling, pricing models. * **Commerce \& ERP:** SFCC (or equivalent), SAP product and order concepts (variant configuration, material master, BOM, pricing), OMS / WMS order flows. * **Tooling:** Git / GitHub, Jira, CI / CD (Azure DevOps or similar), Webpack / Vite, Postman; AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot). **Preferred Certifications** * Salesforce Certified B2C Commerce Developer. * Relevant 3D / WebGL or cloud developer certifications (e.g., AWS or Azure Associate). * Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Success Measures (first 6–12 months)** * **Performance —** The configurator meets performance targets — Largest Contentful Paint and Core Web Vitals within target on mid\-tier mobile, and a stable target frame rate under full option load. * **Configuration\-to\-order accuracy —** A defined, high percentage of configurations resolve to the correct SAP material / SKU, BOM and price with no manual correction. * **Price accuracy —** The configured price matches the ordered and invoiced price. * **Reliability —** Low configurator error and defect rates in production, and high uptime for the configurator and its integrations. * **Fidelity \& safeguards —** On\-screen color matches manufactured output within agreed tolerance, and personalization moderation prevents disallowed content. * **Scalability —** Reusable components and clear documentation reduce time\-to\-launch for new configurable products. **Core Competencies** * Bridges front\-end 3D engineering and enterprise commerce / ERP integration. * Strong systems thinking across product data, pricing and order flows. * Performance and memory debugging in the browser. * Clear communication with creative, commerce and ERP / data teams. * Ownership of and accountability for accuracy from configuration to manufactured product. * Rapidly learns and integrates new interactive and integration technologies.

surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged. * Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure. ***Team Leadership \& Mentorship*** * Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross\-functional team of engineers and designers. * Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning. * Guide the team through iterative delivery. ***Delivery \& Quality*** * Develop the technical roadmap development practices. * Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery. * Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5\) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent management platforms, including hands\-on work with WordPress and Drupal \- theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture. * Proven experience designing, building, and jobs.description: **Job Overview** We're looking for a senior, hands\-on .NET Full Stack Developer to lead three concurrent modernization initiatives: enterprise source control migration, a SharePoint\-to\-GCC cloud migration with AI\-powered search, and legacy application refactoring. **This is not a maintenance role — you will be designing the target architecture, not just executing a checklist.** **Location:** This role requires regular onsite/hybrid presence with client teams and secure environments. Candidates must currently reside in, or be immediately willing to relocate at their own expense to, one of the following metro areas: **New York City, Boston, Washington DC, Chicago, Los Angeles, or San Francisco.** Remote\-only applicants will not be deprioritized. **What You'll Actually Own** **1\. Source Control Modernization: TFS → GitHub** You will not simply move repositories. You will design and document the target GitHub architecture from scratch: repo structure and ownership model, branching strategy, environment promotion flow, CODEOWNERS and required\-reviewer policy, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline design. Deliverable: a written architecture and migration runbook another engineer could execute from. **2\. SharePoint → GCC Cloud Migration** Migrate SharePoint content and permissions into a **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Government / Government Commercial Cloud (GCC / Assured Workloads)**., correctly handling the security model differences, permission inheritance quirks, and compliance boundaries that don't exist in commercial M365\. You will also evaluate and implement an AI\-powered search layer (e.g., Copilot/Graph\-based semantic search, Azure AI Search, or equivalent) to replace native SharePoint search — this is a stated priority, not a stretch goal: * Lead content, data, and workflow migrations from legacy SharePoint environments into **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Government / Government Commercial Cloud (GCC / Assured Workloads)**. * Navigate strict government security boundaries, IAM, compliance controls (FedRAMP/NIST), and GCP storage architectures. * **Implement AI Search:** Replace default legacy SharePoint search with advanced AI\-driven cognitive search using **Google Vertex AI Search / Enterprise Search** (vector search, semantic query processing, and RAG architectures). **3\. Legacy Application Refactoring** * Unpack, analyze, and refactor complex legacy monoliths written in **older .NET Frameworks (Web Forms, WCF, MVC) and legacy VB code (VB.NET / VB6\)**. * Re\-architect legacy logic into modular, high\-performance **modern .NET (NET 8\+) APIs** with **React** frontends. **Responsibilities** To be direct: this role is scoped for someone who has actually done this work before, not someone who can describe it. Applications lacking verifiable specifics below will not be considered. * **7\+ years** professional full stack development experience, including **3\+ years** with React (or a comparable modern SPA framework) paired with a .NET backend * Demonstrated, describable experience with **at least one** enterprise source\-control migration (TFS/SVN/other → Git\-based platform) where you owned the target repo/branching architecture — not just ran the migration tool * Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft 365 GCC or GCC High**, including its security/compliance differences from commercial M365 (you should be able to speak to specific differences unprompted) * Working experience with at least one AI\-powered enterprise search implementation (Azure AI Search, Copilot/Graph connectors, or similar) * Direct experience reading, maintaining, or migrating **VB.NET or classic ASP.NET/WebForms** code — this is a required skill, not a preference * Strong SQL Server skills (schema design, performance tuning, migration scripting) * **Must be prepared to complete a technical assessment:** a scoped architecture and a live technical discussion where you walk through actual reasoning on a comparable migration/refactor scenario. This is how we verify hands\-on depth — resume claims alone won't move you forward. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Boomi or another iPaaS platform * Prior consulting/professional\-services background across multiple concurrent clients * Familiarity with legal, financial services, or another regulated industry's compliance constraints Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * What specific challenge have you faced when migrating legacy TFC version control history to GitHub Git repositories, and how did you resolve it? * Describe one migration or refactor you personally architected — what was the before/after, and what tradeoff did you make that someone without hands\-on experience wouldn't know to make? * What's one concrete difference between SharePoint permissions in commercial M365 vs. GCC that has bitten you or a team you worked with? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * .NET: 8 years (Preferred) * SharePoint: 7 years (Preferred) * CI/CD: 6 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Washington, DC 20590 (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20590

The role will design and build integrations between major enterprise, financial, HR, utility, public safety, asset management, and customer service systems. The position will work closely with City departments, application teams, subject\-matter experts, and technology vendors to understand business processes and translate them into reliable, maintainable integrations. The City’s integration environment includes Workday and other SaaS, vendor\-hosted, and on\-premises business and operational systems. Integration patterns include APIs, web services, secure file exchanges, data transformations, event\-driven workflows, and other system\-to\-system interfaces. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *Essential functions, as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include any of the following representative duties, knowledge, and skills. jobs.title: Project Manager – Data Modernization
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At Cyberlocke, we design solutions for our clients’ most complex technology and data challenges. The Business Analyst will play a key role in supporting our Data Modernization clients by translating business needs into actionable data requirements, facilitating stakeholder discovery, improving data quality and governance, and helping guide the transformation of legacy and fragmented data environments into modern, scalable, analytics\-ready platforms. Our Values * Continuous Learning / Never Satisfied * Does the right thing (even when no one is watching) * Get things done / Reliable * Humble / Confident, with a "One Company" mindset * Helpful/Positive/Can\-do attitude We live our values with each other and with our customers. The Business Analyst serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and Cyberlocke's technical delivery teams, translating business objectives, operational processes, reporting requirements, data challenges, and compliance needs into clearly defined requirements that can be implemented by data architects, data engineers, analytics developers, governance specialists, cloud engineers, and other technical resources. This role is especially important during customer discovery and throughout implementation. The Business Analyst will help clients understand their current data environment, identify business and data requirements, document the desired future state, prioritize use cases, define acceptance criteria, facilitate stakeholder decisions, and ensure delivered solutions address measurable business outcomes. Cyberlocke's Data Modernization practice includes services involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, data integration and transformation, analytics and Power BI, data governance, data quality, cloud data platforms, AI readiness, security and compliance, and ongoing managed data operations. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis capabilities with an understanding of modern data platforms, analytics, governance, and cloud technologies. **Key Responsibilities** **Business Discovery and Requirements Analysis** * Lead and facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements\-gathering meetings with client business and technical teams. * Develop a clear understanding of the client's business objectives, operational processes, data environment, reporting requirements, pain points, risks, and modernization goals. * Translate business needs into clear functional, data, analytics, reporting, governance, security, and operational requirements. * Identify and document business problems that can be addressed through improved data integration, automation, analytics, governance, or modernization. * Define business use cases and expected outcomes for modernization initiatives. * Identify stakeholder priorities and reconcile conflicting requirements between departments or business units. * Help customers distinguish between business requirements, technical requirements, and future\-state opportunities. * Maintain requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle. **Current\-State Assessment** * Assist with assessments of the client's current data ecosystem, including applications, data sources, databases, spreadsheets, reporting platforms, integrations, processes, and business workflows. * Document how information currently moves through the organization. * Identify manual processes, duplicate data entry, reporting inefficiencies, data silos, inconsistent business definitions, data ownership issues, and other operational challenges. * Assist technical teams in identifying source systems and understanding the business context of data contained within those systems. * Develop current\-state process flows, data\-flow documentation, business process maps, and stakeholder maps. * Help identify reporting and analytics dependencies that may be affected by modernization efforts. **Future\-State Data Modernization Planning** * Work with Cyberlocke solution architects and technical teams to translate business requirements into future\-state solution requirements. * Help define the customer's desired future\-state data operating model. * Participate in development of modernization roadmaps, implementation priorities, and phased delivery plans. * Assist customers in prioritizing data sources, reporting requirements, business domains, use cases, and analytics capabilities. * Support development of data modernization strategies involving Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, cloud data platforms, data integration, analytics, governance, and AI readiness. * Help define success criteria an ation. * Assist Project Managers in defining scope, milestones, dependencies, assumptions, and deliverables. * Identify scope changes and requirements that may impact project timelines, resources, or costs. * Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, project status meetings, and other Agile or project\-delivery activities as required. * Maintain requirements and business documentation throughout the project lifecycle. * Support transition from project implementation into operational or managed\-service support when applicable. **Customer Adoption and Change Management** * Identify business processes affected by the modernization initiative. * Help customers understand how new data capabilities will change existing workflows. * Assist in development of user documentation and training requirements. * Support stakeholder communication and adoption activities. * Help identify organizational barriers to adoption and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. * Assist customers with transitioning from legacy reporting and manual processes to new enterprise data and analytics capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or similar role. * Experience gathering and documenting business and technical requirements. * Demonstrated ability to facilitate discovery sessions and stakeholder workshops. * Experience documenting business processes, functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience working with technical implementation teams. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Experience working with structured data, reporting, analytics, or business intelligence solutions. * Understanding of data integration, data quality, analytics, and data governance concepts. * Experience working with executive, business, and technical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple requirements, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting data modernization, cloud migration, data warehouse, data lake, analytics, or digital\-transformation initiatives. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with Power BI. * Experience with Microsoft Azure data services. * Familiarity with OneLake, Lakehouse, data warehouse, Medallion architecture, and modern data\-platform concepts. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview or other data\-governance technologies. * Understanding of ETL/ELT and data\-integration processes. * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL concepts. * Experience developing data dictionaries, business glossaries, or source\-to\-target mappings. * Experience with Agile/Scrum project delivery. * Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, or similar collaboration and project\-management platforms. * Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing technology environments. * Experience supporting enterprise organizations or public\-sector customers. * Familiarity with AI, machine learning, generative AI, and AI\-readiness concepts. **About Cyberlocke** Cyberlocke helps organizations modernize their technology and data environments so they can operate more efficiently, improve decision making, strengthen governance, and prepare for emerging AI capabilities. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** **10% Equity \| PropTech \+ AI \| Founding Team** **The Opportunity** **We are assembling the founding team behind a new company designed to challenge one of the largest and most established consumer industries in America.** **We aren’t ready to publicly share everything we’re building.** **But we can share the thesis:** **AI is about to dramatically change the economics of selling a home. We intend to be ahead of that change.** **We are building a national real estate platform that combines AI\-powered listing technology, transparent flat\-fee services, and an optional layer of in\-person support into a fundamentally different consumer experience.** **Not another lead\-generation company.** **Not another CRM.** **Not another slightly cheaper version of a traditional brokerage.** **Something different.** **And we’re looking for the Founding CTO who wants to build it with us.** **Why This Is Interesting** **Most startups entering real estate eventually encounter the same problem:** **They can build the technology.** **They can raise money.** **They can generate demand.** **But actually operating a brokerage nationally introduces an enormous regulatory and licensing challenge.** **We have an opportunity to approach the market with licensing capabilities across all 50 states from the beginning.** **That changes what can be built.** **Instead of proving a concept in one state and spending years assembling the infrastructure required to expand, our ambition is national from day one.** **Combine that with experienced leadership, strong sales capabilities, direct industry knowledge and a business model that has already attracted significant interest from venture capital, private industry and strategic players, and we believe the ingredients exist to build something unusually large.** **What We’re Building** **We won’t publish the entire product roadmap here.** **The broader vision is straightforward:** **Flat\-fee real estate \+ AI listing technology \+ optional in\-person services.** **We believe homeowners should be able to use technology to handle significantly more of the home\-selling process themselves while having professional assistance available exactly when they need it.** **That means rethinking the entire experience rather than simply digitizing the traditional one.** **The technology could ultimately touch areas including:** **\* AI\-assisted property listing** **\* Pricing and market intelligence** **\* Listing distribution** **\* Marketing automation** **\* Transaction management** **\* Consumer guidance** **\* Showing coordination** **\* Document workflows** **\* Communications** **\* Brokerage operations** **\* Marketplace/service infrastructure** **\* Local, on\-demand assistance** **Some of what we intend to build is obvious.** **Some of it isn’t.** **The latter is a major reason we’re intentionally keeping this description broad.** **Your Role** **You would join as our Founding Chief Technology Officer and a true equity partner.** **This is not a position where someone else hands you a finished product specification and asks you to manage engineers.** **You will help determine what the product becomes.** **You’ll work directly with the founding team to translate a significant industry opportunity into a technology platform capable of operating nationally.** **Early on, you’ll be a builder.** **You’ll architect.** **You’ll prototype.** **You’ll write code.** **You’ll experiment with AI.** **You’ll decide what we build internally and what we integrate.** **You’ll probably kill some ideas and discover better ones.** **As the company grows, you’ll build the engineering organization around the architecture and technical vision you helped establish.** **The Technical Challenge** **We aren’t looking to sprinkle AI on top of an existing brokerage model and call it innovation.** **The question we’re interested in is much larger:** **If you were designing the process of selling a home today, with modern AI, automation and software available from the beginning, how much of the traditional model would you actually recreate?** **That’s the problem we want our CTO thinking about.** **The platform will require a combination of sophisticated consumer software, AI systems, real estate data, APIs, transaction infrastructure, brokerage operations and automation.** **And there is substantial room for the CTO to influence how those pieces come together.** **Who We’re Looking For** **We’re looking for a technical founder, not simply an employee with a CTO title.** **Someone who can move between architecture and execution.** **Someone who can build the first version and eventually recruit the people capable of building the hundredth.** **Experience with several of the following would be valuable:** **\* Full\-stack application development** **\* AI/LLM systems** **\* Agentic AI and automation** **\* API architecture** **\* Cloud infrastructure** **\* Data\-intensive applications** **\* SaaS platforms** **\* Marketplaces** **\* FinTech or PropTech** **\* Payments** **\* Security and privacy** **\* Real estate/MLS data** **\* Scaling engineering organizations** **Real estate experience is helpful, but not necessary.** **The ability to build quickly, think independently and recognize enormous technical leverage is.** **Why Join Now?** **Because the most interesting time to join a company isn’t after everything is obvious.** **It’s before.** **The founding team brings experience across real estate, brokerage operations, strategy, sales, marketing, product development and company growth.** **We have a significant structural advantage that would be difficult for a new entrant to reproduce quickly.** **We have a defined market thesis.** **We have a clear vision.** **And we are intentionally leaving one major seat at the founding table open:** **Technology.** **The person who fills it won’t inherit the technical strategy.** **They’ll create it.** **Compensation** **This is an equity\-first founding opportunity.** **Founding CTO Equity: 10%** **That’s meaningful ownership because we want meaningful commitment.** **We aren’t looking for someone to spend a few hours each week advising us from the sidelines. We want someone who wants to become one of the people who built the company.** **The equity structure would be formally documented with appropriate founder vesting and protections.** **As funding and/or revenue support it, the position is intended to evolve into a compensated executive role while retaining the CTO’s meaningful ownership position.** **The Bigger Picture** **The residential real estate industry represents an enormous amount of consumer spending.** **Technology has changed almost everything surrounding the transaction.** **Search changed.** **Marketing changed.** **Mortgage technology changed.** **Consumer behavior changed.** **And now AI is changing what consumers can reasonably do for themselves.** **We believe that creates a window for a very different kind of real estate company.** **One that combines technology, national brokerage infrastructure and real\-world services rather than choosing between them.** **We have a very specific vision for what that company can become.** **We’re intentionally not putting all of it in a job posting.** **If you’re the kind of technical founder who sees a massive legacy industry and immediately starts wondering how much of it can be rebuilt, we’d like to show you the rest.** Employment Type Pay: $60\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Expected hours: 1\.0 – 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Founding AI Research Lead - Agentic AI Lab
jobs.description: **Founding AI Research Lead \- Agentic AI Lab** *San Francisco Bay Area \| Full time* Backed by 8VC, we are building a world\-class team to tackle one of industry's most critical problems: trusted AI for enterprise operations. **About the Role** Fabrion is designing the future of enterprise AI infrastructure, grounded in agents, knowledge graphs, and multi\-tenant governance. We are working on research inside the Agentic AI Lab to train and evaluate specialized models for mission\-critical enterprise work. The direction is specific and ambitious. We share the full thesis under NDA during the interview process. What we can say here: the program has committed design partners with production data access, dedicated compute, a benchmark\-first plan with clear go and no\-go gates, and a platform team that has already built the governance and serving layer your models will run behind. This is full\-cycle research: problem formulation, data, training, evaluation, and deployment, with your name on the results. **Core Responsibilities** * Own the research agenda: model and training design, evaluation protocol, and the publication plan * Take models from public benchmark results to live customer shadow deployments, with gates you define and defend * Set the benchmark discipline: strong baselines first, published comparables cited, results that survive scrutiny * Lead and grow a small team (ML engineer, data engineer, contractors) and pair closely with the founders and platform team * Write technical plans internally and papers externally when results warrant it **Desired Experience** * Hands\-on experience training sequence models, owning the tokenizer, the training loop, and the evaluation, not only fine\-tuning through APIs * Strong background in at least two of: reinforcement learning (especially offline and imitation settings), sequence decision modeling, structured or constrained generation, learning from event and log data * A track record of shipping research into a product or landing a rigorous benchmark result * PhD in machine learning or a closely related field, or an equivalent research record * Preferred Tech Stack * PyTorch, the Hugging Face ecosystem, experiment tracking and reproducible training pipelines, modern cloud data warehouses, evaluation harness engineering **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * Comfortable as the most senior researcher in the room: setting direction under ambiguity and writing decisions down * Rigor over hype: you distrust your own results until the baselines agree * A teacher's instinct: part of this role is turning strong engineers into researchers **Why This Role Matters** We believe specialized models built on governed enterprise data can run real, multi\-billion\-dollar workflows. Your work will not be buried in research reports. It will be benchmarked in public, deployed to real customers, and activated by hundreds of thousands of decisions.

jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Pflugerville, TX, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; Red Oak, TX, USA; Houston, TX, USA; Pryor Creek, OK, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5 years of experience as a program manager or technical program manager. * 5 years of experience in controls engineering, automation, or systems integration within industrial or mission\-critical environments. * 5 years of experience in BMS/EPMS architectures (including DDC, PLC, virtual machines, and SCADA systems) and with communication protocols including BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP. * Ability to travel 50% of the time to provide on\-site support across various project locations. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Understanding of electrical and mechanical systems to facilitate effective cross\-discipline collaboration. * Ability to trace a failure from a software dashboard back to a physical wiring or sensor issue in the field. * Ability to translate complex automation logic into clear instructions for field technicians and electrical contractors. * Ability to focus on "point\-to\-point" accuracy to ensure 100% data integrity for the facility’s monitoring systems. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to navigate a complex matrix organization. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). Google is looking for a Controls or Systems Engineer with a mastery of Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to execute and deliver the supply of third\-party data center projects. As the primary on\-site technical authority for automation, you will ensure that the "brains" of the facility the integration of mechanical, electrical, and cooling systems are installed and networked to perfection. You will serve as the Lead Technical Point of Contact (POC) for all BMS, EPMS, and PLC\-related engineering questions during the construction phase, ensuring that the physical installation of sensors, controllers, and network architecture aligns with the logical design intent, enabling seamless system communication and operational visibility.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $144000 \- $208000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Provide design development oversight and ensure owner’s requirements are met, act as the definitive resource for integrators and contractors to resolve ambiguities in sequence of operations (SOO), IOLs, and network topology diagrams. * Perform periodic site walk\-throughs to verify the physical installation, ensuring correct placement for accurate readings. * Identify and resolve discrepancies between design intent and field conditions to prevent commissioning delays, ensuring hardware matches programmed logic. * Ensure all installations meet local electrical codes, cybersecurity hardening standards, Google standards, and project\-specific automation requirements. * Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams for resolution of sequence issues, controls intent and changes to the SOO during the construction process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience programming in Python or C\+\+. * 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field. * 3 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms. * 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role. * Experience developing accessible technologies. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Master Complex Hillside Geotechnics, Multi\-Product Logistics, and Advanced Financial Architectures. This senior executive field role demands a rare caliber of construction leader, one who can seamlessly pivot between managing ultra\-luxury custom estates, small\-scale commercial retail hubs, and critical public community infrastructure. resources, and corporate backing to maximize your professional career. **Key Responsibilities** You will hold ultimate profit\-and\-loss (P\&L) accountability, operational scheduling control, and structural oversight across all concurrent building paths within the master\-planned territory:* Diversified Structure \& Master\-Plan Sequencing: Direct concurrent construction pathways, seamlessly coordinating the distinct timelines of high\-end custom residential estates, light commercial developments (culinary villages/retail assets), and public community infrastructure (parks, fire stations). * High\-Elevation Civil Logistics: Mastermind heavy site logistics, bulk earthwork coordination, and structural sequencing required for the construction of dedicated access roads and hillside developments. * Environmental \& Design Enforcement: Enforce compliance with specialized, multi\-layered zoning codes, strict architectural control guidelines, and complex environmental design parameters (such as "dark skies" lighting compliance standards). * Multi\-Trade Orchestration: Command a broad network of construction professionals, driving alignment between civil/structural engineers, institutional general contractors, municipal inspectors, and highly specialized custom residential trade partners. * Advanced Data \& Cost Modeling: Build and maintain dynamic Excel cost product spectrum. * Permitting \& Agency Stewardship: Navigate the complete Clark County planning, zoning, and multi\-layered commercial/residential permitting workflows to ensure uninterrupted comprehensive financial modeling, database integration, and the manual assembly of automated tracking templates. * Geotechnical \& Structural Competency: Deep technical knowledge of complex structural steel configurations, hillside shoring mechanisms, mass grading on high\-elevation rock formations, and full mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) coordination for commercial infrastructure. * Software Infrastructure Proficiency: Hands\-on operational capability navigating industry\-standard construction management platforms (such as Procore or Buildertrend). * Educational Foundation: milestone completion, and margin protection with a robust total rewards framework:* Competitive Base Pay: $125,000\.00 – $155,000\.00 annual base salary customized directly to the depth of your commercial, infrastructure, and luxury custom estate background. * Performance Incentives: Eligibility for high\-yield executive performance bonuses driven directly by project margin retention, schedule execution, and quality control metrics. * Earning Security: Meticulous, dependable weekly pay cycle. * Health \& Wellness Coverages: Access to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision Paid Time Off (PTO), dedicated vacation allocations, and paid company holidays. * Technology Packaging: Premium company\-provided tech equipment setup to support continuous remote, office, and field data logging. *Ready to command a landmark multi\-product portfolio and drive our development legacy forward? Apply today.*

jobs.title: iOS Team Lead - Onsite - Dallas
jobs.description: **Lab49** is an award\-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the world's leading financial institutions. Founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley engineering practices to Wall Street, we have delivered hundreds of high\-impact projects across global investment banks and buy\-side firms, spanning distributed systems, high\-performance automation, enterprise UX, cloud, and data\-driven platforms. At **Lab49,** engineers work directly with clients to design and deliver production systems. We combine technology, design, and business expertise to solve real problems where quality, performance, and clarity matter. **LAB49** is currently looking for an iOS Team Lead who will play a critical role on key projects for Lab49 clients. Working in a collaborative and innovative project team, with direct client\-facing interactions, you will have an opportunity to apply your skills and expertise to design innovative applications that solve complex problems and enhance performance and productivity at our marquis clients. In particular, you will help build and modernize large\-scale consumer banking experiences, focusing on areas such as customer onboarding, account management, and money movement. As part of a greenfield initiative, you will lead the development of new mobile capabilities designed to support expansion into new markets and evolving regulatory requirements. ### **THE ROLE** As an iOS Team Lead, you are a true project leader. You own the technical direction and delivery of client engagements while multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around you. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will design systems, write code when it matters most, guide architectural decisions, and ensure the team delivers high\-quality outcomes even when you are not directly contributing code. You will work closely with client stakeholders, designers, product partners, and Lab49 leadership to ensure solutions are technically sound, aligned with business objectives, and delivered with excellence. This is an on\-site role – 5 days/ week in Richardson, TX ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Design, implement, deliver, and test innovative iOS Swift applications while understanding our products from both a technical and product perspective in the context of our client’s business. * Communicate with leadership, product owners, other technologists and users to create working software based on an understanding of business and technical priorities. * Break down complex problems into elegant technical solutions to intelligently solve problems for Lab49's clients. * Actively contribute to the adoption of strong software architecture, development best practices and new technologies. We are always improving the process of building software; we’ll need your help to do that. * Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends. * Experiment with and learn new technologies. ### **What Success Looks Like** * Your teams consistently deliver high\-quality software that meets user and client objectives. * Engineers around you become more autonomous, capable, and effective because of your leadership. * Clients trust your judgment and rely on you for technical direction and clarity. * You demonstrate strong ownership of outcomes, proactively addressing risks before they become issues. * You can step away from day\-to\-day coding when needed without compromising delivery quality or team performance. ### **What You Should Have** * 10\-12\+ years of experience designing and building complex, commercial\-grade software systems, with 4\+ years leading Agile teams * Proficiency in Swift and experience with native iOS development tools such as SwiftUI, and UIKit * Experience in consumer banking including account management and onboarding. * Familiarity with integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party libraries * Experience with agile development methodologies * Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for mobile applications * Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and best practices to create intuitive and engaging user experiences * Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience in fraud management/KYC/AML and regulatory reporting * Experience using on device biometrics for authentication * A strong portfolio of released applications on the App Store * Experience with AppConfig community standards and enterprise app distribution * College degree in Computer Science or related field of study or equivalent experience * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Copilot) to improve team velocity and code quality, and help the team adopt them responsibly ### **Why Lab49?** At Lab49, you'll work on complex, meaningful challenges alongside talented engineers, designers, and consultants. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies, business domains, and client environments while continuing to grow your career. We value curiosity, judgment, and ownership. If you care about quality, enjoy helping others succeed, and want your work to have a meaningful impact, Lab49 is a place where you can thrive. **Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.** **Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.
